snippet.title: The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkaida! | Ultra HD 4K/60fps | PS1 | PREVIEW | Movie Gameplay Sample
snippet.description:
This is intro and gameplay for The The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkaida! for Playstation.
The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkaida! Walkthrough Gameplay Full Game Part 1 includes the Intro, Review, The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkaida! Single Player No Commentary Story Campaign for Playstation. The Conveni 2: Zenkoku Chain Tenkaida! full game is available on following systems/consoles/platforms: PlayStation, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Playstation Vita, Sega Saturn, PS1, PS3, PSP

DISCLAIMER:
This is 4K ULTRA HD presentation of original Playstation graphics and game appearance captured. It is done this way to preserve original game look through modern footage. No enhancement or smoothing was used.

The second game in the conveni series features different kind of buildings, furnitures, employees for the player to build his own conveni empire. The game now uses a isometric view to show the inside shop graphics.
